# Phase 1.10 — Atomic saves        (implements GENERATION_PLAN.md phase 1.10)
Milestone: `storage.save` writes a temporary file beside the target and moves it into place with `os.replace`, so a failed write leaves the old file intact (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_atomic_save`); `storage.load` raises `ShelfError` naming the path for a truncated or non-JSON file (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_load_errors`); the whole suite stays green (verified by: `python -m unittest discover -s tests`) — verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_atomic_save` ; `python -m unittest tests.test_load_errors` ; `python -m unittest discover -s tests`
Approved: <date>   Planner: <model/effort>   Plan-hash: <sha>

## Context
- scope: atomic saves and clear load errors; depends on nothing; builds on shelf as it stands.
- code: `shelf/storage.py` save, load, loads (FORMAT 2); `shelf/models.py` ShelfError.
- tests in `tests/` (helpers in `tests/helpers.py`).
- the generation plan notes the whole-suite command in HOW_WE_WORK.md has no timeout; that file is the harness, not product code.

## Rationale
- one task per milestone clause, then a whole-suite task; each task adds its own test module.
- product tasks touch only shelf/ and tests/; the new tests write into a tempfile.TemporaryDirectory and stay fast, so the suite needs no timeout.

## Interfaces
- shelf/storage.py: save(path, ...) writes path + temp name in the same directory, then os.replace; removes the temp on failure
- shelf/storage.py: load(path) wraps JSON errors in ShelfError naming the path; loads keeps `unsupported format`
